name: big_cat_roar
character: A big cat: a low, rough roar that swells and sags, then a run of short grunts.
sources: ESTIMATE: typical values for this kind of call written from general knowledge, not measured from a recording and not auditioned. Replace them with numbers from a real recording of the species the project needs.
Fitch (1997), JASA 102: a longer vocal tract puts the resonances lower and closer together
Taylor & Reby (2010), J. Zoology 280: source-filter theory for mammal calls
Wilden, Herzel, Peters & Tembrock (1998), Bioacoustics 9: subharmonics, biphonation and chaos in mammal calls
